name: archspec_diagram
description: Draw an Archspec.rb as a Mermaid flowchart

name: archstrict
description: TypeScript module boundary checker: default-private module surfaces, layers, cycles, and a todo freeze that can only shrink.

name: autospawn
description: Attach-or-spawn launcher for stdio programs, such as MCP servers, so a secret-resolving wrapper starts once and every client shares it.

name: bulldogger
description: Ruby execution evidence for coding agents: failure snapshots captured at the moment a test raises, written as files an agent can read and query.

name: @meganemura/depug
description: Measure runtime values in TypeScript test runs instead of guessing them from source.

name: finderscope
description: Turn V8 CPU and heap profiles into short, ranked reports with runnable next commands for coding agents.

name: firstlight
description: Run lint, typecheck, and tests in parallel for a coding agent, and return at the first failure.

name: nukadoko
description: Typed step contracts for Gherkin, so a scenario can be told wrong before it runs. The vocabulary is machine-readable for agents, and every execution leaves a step record the tool measured rather than the agent reported.

name: polylinedb
description: Polyline database: project memory and task tracking for local tools and cloud agents

name: portful
description: Keep one fixed port pointed at whichever git worktree is active, and switch it without restarting the client

name: runtag
description: Record one child process under XDG so an agent can observe pid and exit later.

name: solarsql
description: Typed SQL for SQLite on Cloudflare D1 and Durable Objects: types from the real engine at build time, a command as one transaction, failures as values.

name: spacequery
description: Named queries over the state of one developer's machine: which coding agents run where, which repositories are dirty, which worktrees and sessions sit idle.

name: @meganemura/stow
description: Personal skills for Git checkouts with local host links

name: stryker-agent-reporter
description: A Stryker reporter that writes JSON Lines a coding agent can act on directly
